The crispy skin of this fried hearty salmon puts its texture in a class all its own.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Salmon Meunières are [[Meal]]s that can be made by [[Cooking]] a [[Hearty Salmon]] with [[Tabantha Wheat]] and [[Goat Butter]]. Regular Salmon Muenières can only be made by adding another ingredient with an effect other than hearty. Eating them will restore several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. The crispy skin of Hearty Salmons puts the texture of this dish into a class of its own. After calming [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]], Link can find [[Kheel]] on her own at the [[Warbler's Nest]]. She will ask him to retrieve her sisters for their rehearsal, but she claims that [[Genli]] may be difficult since she wants Salmon Meunière.{{Cite|Can you go tell my sisters in Rito Village to stop ditching rehearsal? They won't listen to me, but they might listen to a scary-looking Hylian like you. Although Genli might be a tough sell. She's probably in the {{Color BotW|Red|kitchen}} yelling, {{Big|"I want some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}!"}}|Kheel|BotW}} When Link speaks to Genli, she explains that she cannot sing until she gets some Salmon Meunière.{{Cite|I know {{Color BotW|Blue|Kheel}} wants me to practice singing with her, but I just can't. Not until I get my {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}!|Genli|BotW}} The rest of their sisters left to retrieve the ingredients, but Genli wonders what is taking them so long.{{Cite|My sisters already left to get {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} ingredients.|Genli|BotW}}{{Cite|What is taking my sisters so long? I thought they were just going to the {{Color BotW|Red|Slippery Falcon}}.|Genli|BotW}} Link can locate and help the sisters put together Salmon Muenière. [[Cree]] is found in [[The Slippery Falcon]], where she will give Link the Goat Butter she bought.{{Cite|If I give you this {{Color BotW|Blue|goat butter}}, will you make some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} for Genli? She should be in the {{Color BotW|Red|kitchen}}.|Cree|BotW}} [[Kotts]] is found at the [[Fishpond in Front of the Village]], fishing for Hearty Salmon.{{Cite|Hiyah! HIYAH! I'm fishing for {{Color BotW|Blue|hearty salmon}}!|Kotts|BotW}} When reminded of her rehearsal, she gives Link the Hearty Salmon she caught.{{Cite|Please take this {{Color BotW|Blue|hearty salmon}} and go make some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} for Genli.|Kotts|BotW}} Finally, [[Notts]] is found on one of the ridges above Rito Village, and she will explain that she finished gathering her ingredients early and so began practicing.{{Cite|It's just that Genli really wanted some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}, so my sisters and I have been looking for ingredients. I finished early, so I was practicing her to kill time.|Notts|BotW}} She gives Link her Tabantha Wheat.{{Cite|Well then...I guess I'll give the {{Color BotW|Blue|Tabantha wheat}} to you! Please make the best {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} for Genli|Notts|BotW}} Returning to Genli, Link can make Salmon Meunière for her. If he gives it to her, she will eat it all. Afterwards, she decides to keep her promise to her sisters and attend the rehearsal.{{Cite|...Huh? My promise to my sisters? I suppose I shouldn't break my promise...|Genli|BotW}} Genli thanks Link for the Salmon Meunière and asks him to attend their rehearsal.{{Cite|Anyway, thank you for the amazing {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}! It was so soft and flaky and delicious! I'll give this rehearsal my all! ♪Come listen later!♪|Genli|BotW}} Only one variation of Salmon Meunière can be made: * '''Hearty Salmon Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Salmon Muenière}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The crispy skin of this fried hearty salmon puts its texture in a class all its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using the default recipe. When eaten, they heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Porgy Meunière * Salmon Risotto * Seafood Meunière }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
